name: guardrails-js
description: Tells Claude when the JavaScript it wrote is unsafe or slow, so it fixes it in the same turn. Node only, no Python, no model calls.

network.title: Look up packages online
network.description: Ask osv.dev and the npm registry about packages before install. Sends package names off your machine. Offline checks still run when this is off.

min_severity.title: Lowest severity to report
min_severity.description: One of critical, high, medium, low, perf.

priming.title: Send rules at session start
priming.description: Give Claude a short rule set for your stack when a session starts.
